method: Requirement-by-requirement evidence reconciliation over the immutable r23 terminal receipt, compact readable exports, qualification receipt, frozen topic bank, and CI/test receipts.

requirements.note: R8 remains the declared parent and is not rewritten.
Ten archived R8 packets and five synthetic cases are covered; production SAA odds changed in the synthetic write-path check.
The executed contract binds the 100-topic bank digest.
Threads 1-100 completed at eight exchanges per I/N branch; invalid attempts did not contribute experience.
All six checkpoints and 432 scheduled I/N/V rows are present.
Compact traces retain the published exposure details, but 74 developmental rows explicitly carry NO_SEPARATE_FIELD_TRACE_PERSISTED.
216 ON/OFF/RESTORED rows are present with matched state, seeds, and explicit accepted run_id.

All 100 review boundaries are persisted, but status counts are 75 ABSTAINED_MALFORMED, 4 ABSTAINED_NO_TARGETS, 21 ABSTAINED_NO_CHANGE, and 0 accepted adjustments. Malformed output is not relabeled as a successful abstention or a developmental update.
Mechanical comparison and trajectory summaries are published; the evaluator artifact does not expose a blind-label mapping, so qualitative blinding is not independently verifiable.
Gemma, GLiNER2.5, DeBERTa, Qwen3-30B, field seeds, probe seeds, call budget, and available Qwen reservation receipts are recorded; private paired request bodies were not persisted.
Current-tip publication is being reduced to readable review artifacts; local canonical binaries remain hash-indexed. The superseded remote commit is preserved in history and is not rewritten.
No Phase Four execution or neural intervention was started; the report gives a planning recommendation only.

interpretation_boundary: The r23 conversation/SAA/readout/removal measurements are interpretable. Introspection-induced treatment effect is not demonstrated because no live review adjustment was accepted; malformed review rows, 74 absent separate field traces, absent evaluator blind mapping, and absent private paired request bodies remain evidence limitations.

findings: 800 accepted transcript rows cover Threads 1-100; all participant/I/N responses are nonempty and paired seeds match.
Six checkpoint files provide 432 I/N/V rows; removal/restoration provides 216 rows.
74 field-trace rows explicitly carry NO_SEPARATE_FIELD_TRACE_PERSISTED; full exposure-to-field-trace coverage is therefore limited.
The published blinded-evaluation artifact supports mechanical comparison counts but does not contain a blind-label mapping, so genuine qualitative blinding cannot be independently verified.
Shared-Interloper reservation receipts are now indexed where available; private paired Gemma request bodies are not persisted in the compact source artifacts.
The removal/restoration export now carries the accepted run_id on its container and every row.
